verdict.rationale: Airweave includes a built-in agentic search mode in which an AI agent iteratively searches your data with tool calling. It uses multiple strategies, reads full documents and navigates entity hierarchies, so users can hand off multi-step retrieval tasks to it. However, this agent is limited to search. The product is otherwise positioned as a developer building block for external agents ("Google Agentspace but without the UI"), not as a general in-product assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that takes tasks beyond search (e.g., managing collections or syncs via natural language), a dashboard/chat UI for delegating to it, and independent hands-on corroboration of the agentic mode.
